name: motoro
description: Motoro - reliable 24x7 roadside assistance and mechanic dispatch platform

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-out.mjs && concurrently -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @rr/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @rr/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @rr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/config && npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/validation && npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/types && npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @rr/web
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply motoro --local -c apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply motoro --remote -c apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-web.mjs && wrangler deploy --env production -c apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run dev
